relationships.evidence_quote: Glut1 is responsible for ECs to maintain the stability of BSCB [12–14, 36], which was significantly downregulated after 48-h of SR

relationships.subject: infiltrating regulatory T cells
relationships.evidence_quote: Similarly, expression levels of tight junctions and glycolysis enzymes were significantly lower in HUVECs co-cultured with Tregs

relationships.subject: sodium lactate
relationships.evidence_quote: The protein expression levels of tight junctions were significantly upregulated by the treatment of sodium lactate, whereas the levels of inflammatory factors were significantly reduced

relationships.subject: sodium lactate
relationships.evidence_quote: We have validated that the supplementation of sodium lactate relieved SR-induced hyperalgesia and EC dysfunction

key_findings: 48-h sleep restriction damaged BSCB/BBB, reduced endothelial Glut1 and glycolysis, and increased infiltrating Tregs in spinal cord
Tregs competing for glucose impaired endothelial glycolysis via mTOR signaling; sodium lactate rescued barrier and hyperalgesia
